actions: Stop welding and wait with the Power Switch ON for the welder to cool.
Allow the welder to return to service automatically after cooling.
Reduce the duration or frequency of welding periods.
label: Thermal-protection / overheating warning screen
meaning: The welder may have overheated and shut down under its internal thermal protection.
prohibited_actions: Do not bypass or disable the protection.

actions: Check the input voltage and ensure it falls within the machine's specified range.
If the input voltage is correct, press the Reset Button on the back of the machine.
label: Low- or over-voltage protection warning
meaning: The machine may be in low- or over-voltage protection.
prohibited_actions: Do not bypass or disable the protection.
